# Device & Load Mode Test

This is a small test file to verify device and load-mode functionality.

## Test Sections

The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog.

### Translation Test

This content should be translated correctly regardless of the device or precision mode used.

- FP32 (full precision)
- FP16 (half precision for CUDA)
- INT8 (quantized for CPU)

All modes should produce correct translations.
